Pivot.trigger: pivot categories into columns applied after two reshapes

Preview.trigger: candidate proposal preview requested before the corresponding Apply command

PreviewComplete.trigger: preview response accepted with rendered rows

PreviewError.trigger: preview response rejected or transport error

LatePreviewCompleteIgnored.trigger: stale preview response arrived after a newer proposal preview owner became current and was ignored

LatePreviewErrorIgnored.trigger: stale preview transport failure arrived after a newer proposal preview owner became current and was ignored

ChoicePreview.trigger: construction-choice-proposals request started for a selected field command

ChoicePreviewComplete.trigger: successful 2xx READY choice preview with non-empty receipt/output IDs and rendered rows for the same command ID

ChoicePreviewError.trigger: choice preview request failed or returned an unusable preview before AddColumn could consume it

PreviewRequestCancelled.trigger: a current pending proposal-preview request was cancelled by net::ERR_ABORTED without changing the public preview observation
